moves.name: Kaleb Johnson
moves.text: Drop candidate: Kaleb Johnson (GB RB) - RotoWire: "miss multiple weeks" (Nov 10); out Weeks 10-12, back about Week 13 (Week 11 is his bye); ~4.2 a game when healthy. No IR slot is left, so holding him costs a roster seat while he is out. The cheapest other bench seat to free instead: T.J. Hockenson (MIN TE), worth ~6 pts to the best lineup through Week 17. Dom's call - never an order.
